title: Presentation of 2023 Young Leader Award to Dr. Ran Xu of Dupont

abstract: Mark Swientoniewski, Chair of the Management Division's Awards Committee, will present the 2023 Young Leader Award to Ran Xu of the DuPont Company. The award which is sponsored by the Chemours Company recognizes a younger chemical for demonstrating outstanding achievements in leadership.

topic: Putting Inclusive Culture and Core Values at the Heart of Innovation, Sustainability and Digital
title: Putting Inclusive Culture and Core Values at the Heart of Innovation, Sustainability and Digital
session_title: Young Leader Award: Connecting Innovation and Sustainability for Positive Impacts and Value Creation
abstract: Market-back and technology-driven innovation with positive impacts for our customers and society, a sustainability lens that significantly broadens value creation options, and a strategy enabled by digital allows DuPont to fulfill its purpose to empower the world with essential innovations to thrive. This talk summarizes YLA award recipient Ran Xu’s career journey on innovation, sustainability and digital while putting an inclusive culture and DuPont’s core values at the heart of this trifecta at DuPont’s Centre of Excellence in Process Scale-up.

topic: Leading Sustainability in Dynamic Times to Have a Positive Impact, Create Value and Engage Customers, Stakeholders and Employees
title: Leading Sustainability in Dynamic Times to Have a Positive Impact, Create Value and Engage Customers, Stakeholders and Employees
session_title: Young Leader Award: Connecting Innovation and Sustainability for Positive Impacts and Value Creation
abstract: A chemical engineer's perspective on the sustainability challenges facing the planet today and the important role of product and process innovation. Sustainability has become a critical issue with significantly increased regulatory and stakeholder expectations. This presentation will focus on addressing the world's most pressing sustainability challenges (including climate change, circularity, nature, water, and substances of concern) using science and innovation and how DuPont is working on lowering its footprint and expanding its handprint through its 2030 sustainability goals.

topic: Challenges in Scaling Biomass-Based Chemical Processes
title: Challenges in Scaling Biomass-Based Chemical Processes
session_title: Young Leader Award: Connecting Innovation and Sustainability for Positive Impacts and Value Creation
abstract: Covation Biomaterials is focused on innovation to produce and supply sustainable, high-performance, biobased materials and has a mission of sustainability at scale. Process development for biobased materials involves numerous challenges which are unique relative to the petro-based chemical industry. This talk will focus on some of these challenges and provide examples of the use of biomass for the production of value-added chemicals.
presenting_author: Keith Hutchenson | Covation Biomaterials, Wilmington, DE
authors: Keith Hutchenson | Covation Biomaterials, Wilmington, DE
